changelog: Strengthened Core Principles with a compact, surface-form heuristic advising the model to MARK risky positions but to demote them in confidence rather than ban them; motivates why verb-object isolation and demonym+locative/appositive cuts are risky for Chinese.

Added an explicit post-ranking 'safety demotion' step to Decision Procedure that (a) detects surface-decidable patterns that previously caused premature/mistranslated boundaries (object-isolating cuts, demonym/ethnonym cuts before PPs/appositives, and comma-cuts followed by PPs or coordinating conjunctions) and (b) pushes those candidates to lower confidence while keeping them as candidates.

Kept [When to Segment], [Priority Rules] and [Output Rules] text unchanged to avoid repeating earlier rejected edits; the new approach operates as an extra conservative reordering stage rather than banning or rewording the priority list.
